description.text:
The fifth POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in two-card packs at its leagues and tournaments from March to September 2007. It finished bringing into English the Japanese promos English players had been missing, the Gold Star Espeon and Umbreon among them, and it is the most sought-after POP set today.

Every card in the packs is non-holo, the Gold Stars too. Holo copies came later in shop products: Mew δ and Pikachu in DP Value Pack 1 (Wal-Mart and Target, September 2007), and Ho-Oh, Lugia, Pelipper δ and Zangoose δ in DP Gift Packs (Target and Toys "R" Us, October 2007). The holo Mew δ and Pikachu are known with their back printed upside down.

tell.text: No foil anywhere on the card.
Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy from the gift blister packs and boxed sets sold at Target and Toys "R" Us in October 2007, which paired it with the same foil Lugia. The blisters held four booster packs and a coin; the boxes added a Theme Deck. It isn't found in POP Series 5 packs, which held only non-holo copies of the set's rares.
